$comment: Cells that must NOT be commissioned, with who holds each and why. A hold is checked before any local evidence is read, so a cell that looks perfect in today's capture still stays held — the holder knows something a capture run cannot see. This file exists because the alternative is a hold that lives only in one agent's session: it is lost on a reset, and the cell is then commissioned by whoever looks next and finds nothing wrong with it. A hold is released by DELETING its entry, which is a reviewed change with a name on it.

held.functional/color-adjustment/canvas: canvas does not implement the colour-adjustment fold, so this cell shows a different picture from its siblings; parity absorbs it at 9.07/15. Release by implementing the fold in scene2d-canvas (with the user) or by removing the cell.
